C1029.title: Chongqing Police Crack "Apple ID Loan" Illegal Operation Involving Over 20,000 Borrowers
C1029.summary: Police in Wuxi, Chongqing, dismantled a nationwide illegal lending scheme known as "Apple ID Loan." Operating under the guise of "Cook Buyback," the criminal group recruited Apple device users seeking loans.
